name: trx-communication-compass
description: TRX Search Communication Compass™ helps professionals reflect on and improve communication in interviews, leadership discussions, and other high-stakes situations. A non-diagnostic thought tool with optional four-module reflection and 24 qualitative archetypes.

interface.longDescription: TRX Search Communication Compass™ helps professionals understand how their messages may be received and communicate more effectively in consequential conversations. Prepare for an interview, practice disagreement with a colleague, navigate leadership or customer discussions, or explore how you organize ideas, identify patterns, respond to resistance, and engage others. Choose a real situation or reflect more deeply through four original modules and 24 provisional archetypes. On request, receive a Communication Strategy Brief, Message & Reception Review, Interview Communication Review, Reflection & Application Guide, Communication Action Reference, or portable Session Snapshot. The Compass supports authentic communication and evidence-based reflection; it is not a personality diagnosis, psychometric assessment, hiring measure, or promise of interview outcomes. ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important details, correct interpretations, and retain your own judgment and decisions.
defaultPrompt: I have an important interview. Can you help me communicate more clearly?
I have had many first interviews without progressing. Can we investigate how I present my experience?
I need to disagree with a colleague without losing the message. Can we practice?

review.commerce_description: Free communication reflection and preparation resource. No payments, subscriptions, or in-plugin purchases.

publication.release_notes: Submission-ready package with official TRX Search metadata and icon. Tested v0.2 communication methodology, four modules, and 24 original archetypes preserved. Fully self-contained candidate experience with requested documents generated in-session; no external guide dependencies.
